$comment: Author-holdings and conflict-of-interest disclosure. Served by GET /api/disclosures/holdings and linked from the SEBI footer. SEBI RA Reg 24(2) requires research analysts to disclose positions in covered securities at the time of publication; even unregistered, this platform follows the convention so a friend can answer 'does the author own this stock?' without asking. Rotate quarterly. Edit by hand — no automation feeds this file.
disclosure_statement: Starbhai is an educational research platform built and maintained by a single person ('starbhai'). The author may hold positions in some securities listed in the SWS Picks or Earnings Watch sections. This file lists those positions with as-of dates. None of the third-party data providers compensate the author or the platform for inclusion or favourable scoring; underlying data is sourced under commercial licences listed below.

stock_holdings.$comment: Populate as a JSON array of { symbol, exchange, sharesHeld, avgEntryInr, firstEntryDate, mostRecentTxnDate, notes }. Empty array means no positions disclosed at the as_of date.

mf_holdings.$comment: Populate as { schemeCode, schemeName, units, avgNavInr, firstSubscriptionDate, notes }. Empty array means no positions disclosed at the as_of date.

third_party_data_providers.name: Simply Wall Street (SWS)
third_party_data_providers.relationship: Data scraped via the platform's deep-stock endpoints; no commercial relationship
third_party_data_providers.platform_used_for: Snowflake scores, fair-value, news briefs, V3 decomposition for ~5,500 NSE/BSE names

third_party_data_providers.name: Yahoo Finance
third_party_data_providers.relationship: Public API consumed via yahoo-finance2 npm package; no commercial relationship
third_party_data_providers.platform_used_for: Live quotes, earnings history, fundamentals history (~494 covered names)

third_party_data_providers.name: National Stock Exchange of India (NSE)
third_party_data_providers.relationship: Public data scraped via authenticated session cookies (run from a local machine — see CLAUDE.md). No commercial relationship
third_party_data_providers.platform_used_for: Event calendar, corporate announcements, bulk/block deals, surveillance lists

third_party_data_providers.name: Groq / Google Gemini
third_party_data_providers.relationship: Pay-per-token LLM APIs for the earnings qualitative-signal component and macro-regime classifier

grievance_contact.$comment: Friends-and-family scale only — no formal SCORES integration since the platform is not SEBI RA registered
